GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO1.title: Rank 1 Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO1.flavor: Rank 1 Gu master Aperture, produces bronze true essence.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO2.title: Rank 2 Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO2.description:
The first [gold]Rank[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] or lower card you play each combat is played for free.
{ProgressDescription}
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO2.flavor: Rank 2 Gu master Aperture, produces hematite true energy.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO3.title: Rank 3 Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO3.description:
The first [gold]Rank[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] or lower card you play each combat is played for free.
{ProgressDescription}
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO3.flavor: Rank 3 Gu master Aperture, produces silver true essence.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO4.title: Rank 4 Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO4.description:
The first [gold]Rank[/gold] [blue]3[/blue] or lower card you play each combat is played for free.
{ProgressDescription}
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO4.flavor: Rank 4 Gu master Aperture, produces golden essence.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO5.title: Rank 5 Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO5.description:
The first [gold]Rank[/gold] [blue]4[/blue] or lower card you play each combat is played for free.
{ProgressDescription}
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO5.flavor: Rank 5 Gu master Aperture produces amethyst true energy.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO6.title: Rank 6 Immortal Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO6.description:
When obtained, raise your Max HP by [blue]6[/blue]. At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Green Grape Immortal Essence[/gold] into your hand.
{ProgressDescription}
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO6.flavor: Rank 6 Immortal Aperture produces Green Grape Immortal Essence.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO7.title: Rank 7 Immortal Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO7.description:
When obtained, raise your Max HP by [blue]7[/blue]. At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Red Date Immortal Essence[/gold] into your hand.
{ProgressDescription}
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO7.flavor: Rank 7 Immortal Aperture produces Red Date Immortal Essence.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO8.title: Rank 8 Immortal Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO8.description:
When obtained, raise your Max HP by [blue]8[/blue]. At the start of each combat, add a [gold]White Litchi Immortal Essence[/gold] into your hand.
{ProgressDescription}
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO8.flavor: Rank 8 Immortal Aperture produces White Litchi Immortal Essence.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO9.title: Rank 9 Immortal Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO9.description:
When obtained, raise your Max HP by [blue]9[/blue]. At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Yellow Apricot Immortal Essence[/gold] into your hand.
{ProgressDescription}
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO9.flavor: "Everyone please remember that I, Gu Yue Fang Yuan, am the Great Love Immortal!"
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO_PROGRESS.gai: At the end of combat, gain [blue]1[/blue]/[blue]3[/blue]/[blue]5[/blue] [gold]Cultivation[/gold] from normal/Elite/Boss combats.

The current rank of your Aperture. Vital Gu can only reach Rank 9.

GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO_PROGRESS.rea: Right-click this relic outside combat to prepare for tribulation.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO_PROGRESS.bre: After passing [red]{Tribulation}[/red], undergo Venerable Ascension in the next combat.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_KONG_QIAO_PROGRESS.can: Right-click this relic outside combat to cancel Immortal Ascension.

GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_GU_CAN_HAI.title: Immortal Gu Remains
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_GU_CAN_HAI.descri: Your next Smith at a Rest Site is free. [blue]{ExtraSmith}[/blue] times remain.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_GU_CAN_HAI.flavor: The wreckage left after the destruction of Immortal Gu still retains some traces of the path.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_LI_DAO_DAO_HEN.title: Strength Path Dao Mark
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_LI_DAO_DAO_HEN.descrip: Start each combat with [blue]X[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. (X being the number on this relic)
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_LI_DAO_DAO_HEN.flavor: The traces of Strength Path engraved on the Gu Master's body will turn into real Strength after accumulation.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NI_LIU_HE.title: Reverse Flow River
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NI_LIU_HE.description: Reflect the next [blue]{Water}[/blue] instances of unblocked attack damage you would take back to the attacker. Gains 1 charge, whenever you advance one floor, up to {MaxWater}.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NI_LIU_HE.flavor: Rule Path, the secret realm of heaven and earth, can counter all attacks.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_JIAN_MIAN_CENG_XIANG_S: At the start of the next [blue]{Battles}[/blue] combats, apply {FriendStacks} [gold]Friend[/gold] to ALL enemies. When 0 charges remain or this Relic is Right-clicked, it will be converted into a card and returned to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Transformation Path, the fairy-level Killer Move, comes from the Thieving Demon Lord.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TU_DUI_GU.title: Soil Mound Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TU_DUI_GU.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Piled Earth[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TU_DUI_GU.flavor: Rank 2 Earth Path Gu, which can generate mounds and solidify the defense.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_BI_GU_YI_GU.title: Arm Bone Wings Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_BI_GU_YI_GU.descriptio: On the first turn of combat, the first Attack you play is played an extra time.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_BI_GU_YI_GU.flavor: Rank 3 Bone Path Gu can grow a pair of bone wings on the forearm. By fanning the bone wings, the shooting speed can be increased.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_JIAN_MEI.title: Sword Eyebrows
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_JIAN_MEI.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Sword Edge[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_JIAN_MEI.flavor: Able to imprint Sword Path Dao Mark in eyebrows.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_LUO_PO_GU.title: Luo Po Valley
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_LUO_PO_GU.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_LUO_PO_GU.flavor: The secret realm of Soul Dao Heaven and Earth is the first choice for soul refining.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GU_CI_GU.title: Bone Spike Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GU_CI_GU.description: At the start of each combat, lose [blue]1[/blue] HP and gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GU_CI_GU.flavor: Rank 3 Bone Path Gu can cause the bones all over the body to mutate, producing sharp and hard Bone Spikes.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TIE_GU_GU.title: Iron Bone Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TIE_GU_GU.description:
Upon pickup, lose [blue]3[/blue] Max HP.
At the start of each combat, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Plated Armor[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TIE_GU_GU.flavor: Rank 3 Bone Path Gu can make the Gu Master's bones as hard as iron.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NONG_XU_GU.title: Fabrication Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NONG_XU_GU.description: At the start of each combat, add a random [gold]Phantom[/gold] into your hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NONG_XU_GU.flavor: The virtual Gu can fabricate Phantom out of thin air.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_YAN_XIN_GU.title: Flame Heart Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_YAN_XIN_GU.description: At the start of your turn, add a [gold]Blaze[/gold] into your hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_YAN_XIN_GU.flavor: Flame Heart Gu is placed in the heart and has the effect of enhancing fire-type Gu.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NENG_LI_GU.title: Ability Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NENG_LI_GU.description: Whenever you play a Power, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_NENG_LI_GU.flavor: Rank 8 Strength Path Immortal Gu is recorded in "The Legend of Human Ancestors" and can continue to grow in Tribulation.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CHI_XIANG.title: Eat Fragrance
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CHI_XIANG.description: Whenever a non-Minion enemy dies, heal 1 HP. [gold]Food Path[/gold] killing effects are doubled.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CHI_XIANG.flavor: Rank 6 Food Path Immortal Gu, shaped like a wooden box and compact.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FEI_LI_GU.title: Waste Effort Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FEI_LI_GU.description: At the start of your turn, ALL enemies with [gold]Strength[/gold] lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FEI_LI_GU.flavor: It can make every move of enemy waste more Effort and double the loss on Strength.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FEI_GU_DUN_GU.title: Flying Bone Shield Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FEI_GU_DUN_GU.descript: Ignore the next [blue]{Uses}[/blue] times you would take damage.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FEI_GU_DUN_GU.flavor: Bone Path Gu can fly out of the bone shield to resist external attacks.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CUN_GUANG_YIN.title: Inch of Time
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CUN_GUANG_YIN.descript: Whenever you Smith, upgrade [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CUN_GUANG_YIN.flavor: Time flies, and it’s hard to buy Inch of Time with even a small amount of money.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_ROU_BAI_GU.title: Flesh on White Bone
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_ROU_BAI_GU.description: At the end of combat, heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP if you lost HP during that combat.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_ROU_BAI_GU.flavor: Flesh on White Bone, the living and the dead.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_MU_YA.title: Wood Sprout
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_MU_YA.description: Every [blue]{Threshold}[/blue] times you [gold]Exhausted[/gold] a card, add a random [gold]Wood Path[/gold] card into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_MU_YA.flavor: A Wood Path sprout that has just broken ground.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SI_XU_RU_DIAN_GU.title: Lightning Thought Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SI_XU_RU_DIAN_GU.descr: Whenever you gain [gold]Thought[/gold], deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SI_XU_RU_DIAN_GU.flavo: Thoughts are like electricity, and Thought is about to move.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SHUI_WEN_GU.title: Hydrology Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SHUI_WEN_GU.descriptio: Play cards with a total of [blue]{Threshold}[/blue] letters in their names to gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SHUI_WEN_GU.flavor: This is Hydrology Gu, withdraw quickly, we readers are most afraid of hydrology.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GOU_SHI_YUN.title: Dumb Luck
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GOU_SHI_YUN.descriptio: Combat rewards have a [blue]{Chance}[/blue]% Chance to contain an additional Relic.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GOU_SHI_YUN.flavor: One of the essences of Qi Luck True Tradition, which can significantly enhance Qi Luck.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_HONG_YUN_QI_TIAN_GU.de: The [gold]Chance[/gold] of your [gold]Chance[/gold] cards is increased by [blue]{ProbabilityBonus}[/blue]%. The chance of receiving [gold]Rare[/gold] card rewards doubles.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_HONG_YUN_QI_TIAN_GU.fl: Good luck reaches the sky, and luck is like a rainbow.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FENG_XIONG_HUA_JI.desc: Whenever you would obtain a Curse, obtain a random card instead.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_FENG_XIONG_HUA_JI.flav: Luck Path Gu that turns disaster into opportunity.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TOU_SHENG.title: Steal Life
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TOU_SHENG.description: Right-click during combat to steal {StealAmount} Max HP from ALL enemies. Can be used {Uses} times.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_TOU_SHENG.flavor: Rank 8 Theft Path Immortal Gu can steal the lifespan of all HP.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO10.title: Rank 10 Immortal Aperture
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO10.descriptio: When obtained, raise your Max HP by [blue]10[/blue]. At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Yellow Apricot Immortal Essence[/gold] into your hand and gain [gold]Eternal Life[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_QIAO10.flavor: The winding road is narrow and the world is narrow, and the life and death of Tribulation are complicated.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_DING_XIAN_YOU.title: Fixed Immortal Travel
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_DING_XIAN_YOU.descript: You may ignore paths when choosing the next rooms to travel to.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_DING_XIAN_YOU.flavor: The legendary Yudao Immortal Gu recorded in "The Legend of Human Ancestors", the world is so big that there is nowhere it cannot go.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GUI_BU_JUE.title: Ghostly Concealment
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GUI_BU_JUE.description:
Ghost enemies cannot target you with their actions.
(Includes: Haunted Ship, Phantasmal Gardener, Soul Fysh, Soul Nexus, Spectral Knight, The Lost, The Forgotten, Torch Head Amalgam, and Vantom.)
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_GUI_BU_JUE.flavor: Rank 9 Theft Path Killer Move, which can protect against the perception of ghosts.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_JIAN_CHI_GU.title: Perseverance Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_JIAN_CHI_GU.descriptio: Each buff is prolonged once, the first time it disappears due to the end of its duration.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_JIAN_CHI_GU.flavor: Persistence is not difficult, what is difficult is persisting to the end.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_ANGRY_BIRD.desc: Requires: [gold]Magma Burst Gu+[/gold], any [gold]Fire Path Immortal Gu[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_ANGRY_BIRD.flav: Fire Path Killer Move Gu recipe condenses the fiery Blaze into one blow.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_YANG_MANG_BEI_H: Killer Move - Verdant Sun Flame Cloak
Requires: [gold]Flame Armor Gu+[/gold], any [gold]Fire Path Immortal Gu[/gold].
The ultimate secret of Fire Path is to make your hair burn and turn into a huge flame cloak to protect your whole body.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_ZHUI_MING_HUO.d: Requires: [gold]Prairie Fire+[/gold], any [gold]Fire Path Immortal Gu[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_ZHUI_MING_HUO.f: Can sense the offensive, trace the source, and directly burn Immortal Aperture. As long as HP continues, this fire will continue to burn.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_WAN_XING_FEI_YI: Requires: [gold]Star Thought Gu+[/gold], any [gold]Wisdom Path Immortal Gu[/gold].
As soon as this move comes out, the sky and the earth are darkened, and night falls for thousands of miles around, every Thought thought by the Gu Immortal will form a star Thought.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_XING_XIU_QI_PAN: Requires: [gold]Wisdom Gu[/gold], any [gold]Wisdom Path Immortal Gu[/gold].
The first Immortal Gu house in history has the world’s best Deduction capabilities.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_JIAN_LANG_SAN_D: One stack of sword waves is higher than the other, three waves in a row, and the power increases layer by layer.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_JIAN_MIAN_CENG_: Requires: [gold]Attitude Gu+[/gold], any [gold]Transformation Path[/gold] or [gold]Theft Path[/gold] Gu.
Transformation Path, the fairy-level Killer Move, comes from the Thieving Demon Lord.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_SAN_SHI_SAN_TIA: Light Path Killer Move, the more Radiance you accumulate, the more amazing the explosion will be.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_SHANG_FANG_JIE_: Killer Move - Tear Off the Roof
Requires: [gold]Rampage Gu+[/gold], any [gold]Strength Path Immortal Gu[/gold].
It is extremely restrained from Defense-type states, and even strong Defense means can be forcibly broken.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_SONG_YOU_FENG.d: Requires: [gold]Eight-sided Majestic Gu[/gold], any [gold]Wind Path[/gold] or [gold]Rule Path[/gold] Gu.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_SONG_YOU_FENG.f: Wind Path Killer Move, give you a ride, and create Friend cause and effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_AN_QI_SHA.title: Killer Move - Dark Fork Assassination
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_AN_QI_SHA.descr: Requires: [gold]Flying Sword+[/gold], [gold]Sword Shadow Gu[/gold] or [gold]Multiple Sword Shadow Gu[/gold] or [gold]Stacking Shadow Gu[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_AN_QI_SHA.flavo: The sword moves extremely fast, as fast as lightning.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_JIAN_HEN_SUO_MI: Killer Move - Sword Marks Claim Life
Requires: [gold]Flying Sword Gu+[/gold], any [gold]Sword Path Immortal Gu[/gold].
Sword Mark carves into the target's Weaknesses, claiming lives invisibly.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_WAN_WO.title: Killer Move - Myriad Self
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_WAN_WO_DA_SHOU_: Killer Move - Myriad Self Giant Hand
Requires: [gold]Uproot Mountain+[/gold], any [gold]Strength Path Immortal Gu[/gold].
Gather the power of the crowd in one palm.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_WU_ZHI_QUAN_XIN: After fifty-four tribulations, the clouds of tribulation still cover the sky.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_XUE_JIAN_LENG.f: With Cold Blood Gu as the core, enemy's blood is quickly cooled until it freezes.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_XUE_PIAO_LIU.de: Requires: [gold]Blood Rush Gu+[/gold], any [gold]Blood Path Immortal Gu[/gold].
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_XUE_PIAO_LIU.fl: The long river of blood carries the user's Flight in the air, and a strong bloody atmosphere escapes wherever he goes.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_ZHU_MO_BANG.fla: The Rank 8 Blood Path Immortal Gu house created by Tianting records the information of the five realms of magic and has almost no shortcomings.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_TIAN_PU_GUANG_H: Killer Move - Heavenly Waterfall Light River
Requires: [gold]Great Light Gu+[/gold], any [gold]Light Path Gu[/gold].
The river of light is rolling, the waves are tumbling, and every drop of the surging light water is like a fragment of the sun, dazzling to the extreme.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_WU_JIN_XUAN_GUA: Killer Move - Five Restrictions Profound Light Qi
The mysterious light of the Five Forbiddens has been dim for two days, and Rank 8 Killer Move has trapped the two deities.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_WAN_WU_DA_TONG_: Killer Move - Myriad Beings Assimilation Transformation
Requires: [gold]Adaptation+[/gold], any [gold]Transformation Path[/gold] or [gold]Strength Path[/gold] Gu.
The supreme secret of Transformation Path can transform all things and make all things unified.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_GUANG_YIN_FEI_R: Requires: [gold]Blade Gu[/gold], any [gold]Time Path Immortal Gu[/gold].
"When this blade comes out, there will be no miss, no miss, and no fatal blow."
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_BAI_GU_ZHAN_CHE: Requires: [gold]Battle Bone Wheel+[/gold], any [gold]Bone Path Gu[/gold].
The number one Killer Move in the world is powerful, comparable to Rank 6 Immortal Gu.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_AN_TU_ZHONG_SHA: Killer Move - Peaceful Earth Heavy Mountain Fortress
Rank 8 Earth Path Immortal Gu house, Defense has the best capabilities of Rank 8.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SHEN_BU_ZHI.title: Divine Concealment
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SHEN_BU_ZHI.descriptio: You will no longer encounter any tribulations.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_SHEN_BU_ZHI.flavor: Rank 9 Theft Path Killer Move can shield the detection of Will.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CHUN_QIU_CHAN.title: Spring Autumn Cicada
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CHUN_QIU_CHAN.descript: Right-click outside of combat to travel back in time. The failure rate is [blue]{FailChance}[/blue]%, increasing by 10% after each use. Inactive for [blue]{Cooldown}[/blue] floors after use. {Snapshots} time nodes are currently saved.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_CHUN_QIU_CHAN.flavor: Spring Autumn Cicada maintains vitality with the water of the long river of time, and has the ability to rebirth people into the past.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.title: Rank Nine Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.flavor: Once the immortal fetus is formed, tribulations cannot touch it. At sovereign rank nine, myriad calamities cannot shake it.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.no_tribula: [gold]Sovereign immortal aperture. Tribulations are not required.[/gold]
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.preview_ef:
When obtained, inherits the rank and progress of your current aperture.
[gold]Sovereign immortal aperture. Tribulations are not required.[/gold]
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.rank_2_eff: The first [gold]Rank[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] or lower card you play each combat is played for free.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.rank_3_eff: The first [gold]Rank[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] or lower card you play each combat is played for free.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.rank_4_eff: The first [gold]Rank[/gold] [blue]3[/blue] or lower card you play each combat is played for free.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.rank_5_eff: The first [gold]Rank[/gold] [blue]4[/blue] or lower card you play each combat is played for free.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.rank_6_eff: When obtained, raise your Max HP by [blue]6[/blue]. At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Green Grape Immortal Essence[/gold] into your hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.rank_7_eff: When obtained, raise your Max HP by [blue]7[/blue]. At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Red Date Immortal Essence[/gold] into your hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.rank_8_eff: When obtained, raise your Max HP by [blue]8[/blue]. At the start of each combat, add a [gold]White Litchi Immortal Essence[/gold] into your hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_XIAN_TAI_GU.rank_9_eff: When obtained, raise your Max HP by [blue]9[/blue]. At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Yellow Apricot Immortal Essence[/gold] into your hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RELIC_RECIPE_YIN_GUO_SHEN_SH: Requires: [gold]Heavenly Essence Treasure Lotus+[/gold], any [gold]Rule Path[/gold] or [gold]Luck Path Immortal Gu[/gold].
In this world, every cause has an effect, and every effect has a cause.
